Pages 1, 7, 9-12, 14-25, 28-31, and 34 had to be converted as they were over the maximum filesize. However, I did this by massaging the PNG format, so they should be pixel-for-pixel visual duplicates, they will simply hash differently from the original files.
Pages 10 and 21, however, I couldn't get below 53MB each as PNGs, so I had to reduce their resolution by ~3%.

The comic begins with a "chapter 0" prologue to introduce the concept and establish the consent of the main character.

And as Vellum includes with the pages to this comic:
"Consensual-non-consent is the roleplaying of non-consent in a safe and purely fantastical manner. Such roleplay should be done safely and responsibly with full communication and consent between all parties. Any and all of my art depicting CNC is explicitly in the context that all communication and consent has been given with all characters depicted prior to any scene"
